source.title: Open problems in some competition models

accepted.question_text: Consider the two-species Ricker competition system x_{n+1}=x_n e^{K-x_n-a y_n}, y_{n+1}=y_n e^{L-y_n-b x_n} on the positive quadrant, where K,L>0 are carrying capacities and a,b∈(0,1) are competition parameters. Its coexistence fixed point is ((aL-K)/(ab-1),(bK-L)/(ab-1)). Assume the local stability inequality 4(ab-1)+2(1-a)L+2(1-b)K ≤ (aL-K)(bK-L) < (1-a)L+(1-b)K holds. Is this coexistence fixed point globally asymptotically stable in the positive first quadrant for every parameter pair satisfying that inequality?

evidence.quote: In [2], the authors considered the Ricker competition model given by x_{n+1}=x_n e^{K-x_n-a y_n}, y_{n+1}=y_n e^{L-y_n-b x_n}, where (x,y) ∈ R_+^2. The parameters K, L > 0 are the carrying capacities of species x and y, respectively. Moreover, the competition parameters a and b are in the interval (0,1).
The coexistence fixed point (x^*, y^*) = ((aL-K)/(ab-1), (bK-L)/(ab-1)) of the Ricker equation (1) is asymptotically stable if 4(ab-1)+2(1-a)L+2(1-b)K ≤ (aL-K)(bK-L) < (1-a)L + (1-b)K.
Conjecture 1.2. Under condition (2), the coexistence fixed point (x^*, y^*) is globally asymptotically stable in the positive first quadrant, for all (K, L) ∈ Int(S_1).

accepted.question_text: For the two-species Ricker competition system x_{n+1}=x_n e^{K-x_n-a y_n}, y_{n+1}=y_n e^{L-y_n-b x_n} with K,L>0 and a,b∈(0,1), determine the stability type of the exclusion fixed point (K,0) in the boundary case K=2 and L=bK, where the Jacobian eigenvalues are λ_1=-1 and λ_2=1.

evidence.quote: In [2], the authors considered the Ricker competition model given by x_{n+1}=x_n e^{K-x_n-a y_n}, y_{n+1}=y_n e^{L-y_n-b x_n}, where (x,y) ∈ R_+^2. The parameters K, L > 0 are the carrying capacities of species x and y, respectively. Moreover, the competition parameters a and b are in the interval (0,1).
Open problem 1.5. (1) Determine the stability of the fixed point (K,0) when K = 2 and L = bK. In this case, the eigenvalues of the Jacobian of the map of equation (1) are λ_1 = -1 and λ_2 = 1.

accepted.question_text: For the two-species Ricker competition system x_{n+1}=x_n e^{K-x_n-a y_n}, y_{n+1}=y_n e^{L-y_n-b x_n} with K,L>0 and a,b∈(0,1), determine the stability type of the exclusion fixed point (0,L) in the boundary case L=2 and L=K/a, where the Jacobian eigenvalues are λ_1=1 and λ_2=-1.
accepted.context_brief: Ricker second boundary exclusion fixed point

evidence.quote: In [2], the authors considered the Ricker competition model given by x_{n+1}=x_n e^{K-x_n-a y_n}, y_{n+1}=y_n e^{L-y_n-b x_n}, where (x,y) ∈ R_+^2. The parameters K, L > 0 are the carrying capacities of species x and y, respectively. Moreover, the competition parameters a and b are in the interval (0,1).
Open problem 1.5. (2) Determine the stability of the fixed point (0,L) when L = 2 and L = K/a. In this case, the eigenvalues of the Jacobian of the map of equation (1) are λ_1 = 1 and λ_2 = -1.

accepted.question_text: Consider the logistic competition system x_{n+1}=a x_n(1-x_n)/(1+c y_n), y_{n+1}=b y_n(1-y_n)/(1+d x_n), where x,y∈[0,1], c,d∈(0,1), and a,b∈(0,4]. Determine the stability type of the boundary fixed point ((a-1)/a,0) in the parameter case a=3 and b=1+d(a-1)/a.

evidence.quote: In [1], the authors considered the following logistic competition model: x_{n+1} = a x_n(1-x_n)/(1+c y_n), y_{n+1} = b y_n(1-y_n)/(1+d x_n), where x, y ∈ [0,1], c, d ∈ (0,1) and a, b ∈ (0,4].
Open problem 2.5. (1) Determine the stability of the fixed point ((a-1)/a,0) of equation (3) if a = 3 and b = 1 + (d(a-1)/a).

accepted.question_text: Consider the logistic competition system x_{n+1}=a x_n(1-x_n)/(1+c y_n), y_{n+1}=b y_n(1-y_n)/(1+d x_n), where x,y∈[0,1], c,d∈(0,1), and a,b∈(0,4]. Determine the stability type of the boundary fixed point (0,(b-1)/b) in the parameter case b=3 and a=1+c(b-1)/b.
accepted.context_brief: Logistic competition second boundary fixed point

evidence.quote: In [1], the authors considered the following logistic competition model: x_{n+1} = a x_n(1-x_n)/(1+c y_n), y_{n+1} = b y_n(1-y_n)/(1+d x_n), where x, y ∈ [0,1], c, d ∈ (0,1) and a, b ∈ (0,4].
Open problem 2.5. (2) Determine the stability of the fixed point (0,(b-1)/b) of equation (3) if b = 3 and a = 1 + (c(b-1)/b).
